judgments.reason: The model's text only records filing and redeem actions (e.g. repeated [report: 3]) but does not articulate the mechanism that an inflated report congruent modulo seven is accepted and credited; it merely follows normal accepted same-digit reports in the transcript without claiming or explaining the modulo-7 discrepancy.

The model_actions list contains only filing and redeem statements and no explanation of an audit/amendment ordering bug or an observed instance where an original audited report was replaced by an amendment in the crediting; no mechanism describing rule-order precedence is articulated or tied to the transcript.

Although the transcript shows multiple redemptions by different players and one redemption recorded for the focal certificate, the model statement does not articulate a mechanism that the same certificate can be used to pay repeatedly (resource duplication). The model never explains how repeated credits would bypass the one-redemption rule.

The model text contains no claim or mechanism explaining that the clerk reveals accepted inflated reports contrary to the equal-digit rule; it only performs filings and redeems, so no discovery of a meta-rule violation is articulated or connected to observed outcomes.
